items.title: Pure convergence/takeover breaker core deriving three counters from story.events
items.context: New core/convergence-breaker.ts. Read-only derive: (a) total story_advance count, (b) review pass-rate = review_pass_set/review_run_start over a windowed min-sample, (c) takeover frequency = lease-takeover events / takeover-flagged commands over a window. Pure decision fn assessBreaker(inputs) -> {tripped, reasons[], severity}. No I/O; mirror the purity discipline and event-scanning of core/review-convergence.ts (reuse resolveReviewRoundCount, do not reimplement round logic).
items.userSees: The new smoke prints: assessBreaker returns tripped=true reasons=[advance-count 89>20, pass-rate 31/131=24%<35%, takeover 65>5] for the B-f458 fixture, and tripped=false for the healthy 8-advance converging fixture.

happy.desc: A healthy converging story (8 advances, passing reviews, no takeover storm) yields assessBreaker tripped=false

edge.desc: Pass-rate cannot trip below the min-sample review-run count (0 of 1 runs reads as insufficient sample, not 0%)

adversarial.desc: A malformed or missing review ledger makes assessBreaker fail open (tripped=false) and never throws

items.title: Graduated freeze state with a one-shot auto-recovery budget, persisted as a gitignored runtime artifact
items.context: Persist per-story breaker state (tripped reasons + counter snapshot + auto-recovery budget) under .lattice/story/actives/<id>/, registered in core/runtime-artifact-registry.ts with a matching .gitignore glob so it is never tracked (follow the story-owner-lease.ts F-008 dirty-write-prevention pattern). First trip -> auto-recover once (re-baseline the window, no human). Re-trip with budget exhausted -> frozen.
items.userSees: After a first trip the breaker-state file shows autoRecoveriesSpent=1 and the story still advances; after a re-trip it shows frozen=true. git status never lists breaker-state.json.

happy.desc: First pathological trip writes state, spends the one-shot budget (autoRecoveriesSpent=1), and the advance proceeds

edge.desc: A re-trip after the budget is spent flips frozen=true instead of auto-recovering again

adversarial.desc: breaker-state.json is gitignored: a DONE-style merge with the file present is not blocked by the dirty-tree/F-008 check

items.title: Enforce the freeze at story_advance and takeover-command entry with a human-only ack resume
items.context: When frozen, hard-block mutating lifecycle/advance commands with a rejection that names the tripped counters and points at the authoritative next action (existing done_prepare --dryRun / proofstory gate-check). Clear only via a new resume/ack command that refuses under autopilot / non-interactive mode. Reuse the non-owner rejection gate pattern in core/story-owner-lease.ts + command-policy ownershipClass; do not weaken the single legitimate forceTakeover.
items.userSees: A frozen story blocks story_advance with "CONVERGENCE BREAKER: story <id> is FROZEN" naming the tripped counters; story_resume --ack --reason clears it interactively; under LATTICE_AUTOPILOT=1 story_resume is refused with "requires an interactive human session".

happy.desc: A frozen story rejects story_advance with a message naming the tripped counters and the authoritative next action

edge.desc: story_resume --ack --reason=... in an interactive session clears the freeze and the next advance proceeds

adversarial.desc: story_resume under a simulated autopilot/non-interactive env is refused so a looping agent cannot self-ack

items.title: Env-tunable thresholds with evidence-derived defaults
items.context: LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_ADVANCE (~20), LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MIN_PASS_RATE + min-sample, LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_TAKEOVER per window. Mirror resolveBurnAlertThresholds env-resolver (typo-safe fallback, per-variable sanity ceilings). Derive defaults from B-f458: normal is 6-10 advances and ~1 takeover; the storm was 89 advances / 65 takeovers / pass-rate collapsing to <10%.
items.userSees: With LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_ADVANCE=5 the fixture trips at 6 advances; unset uses the default 20; a garbage value (abc / -1 / 1e9) falls back to the default with no crash.

happy.desc: Default thresholds resolve to advance ~20, takeover ~5/window, and a min pass-rate with a min-sample gate

edge.desc: An env override (e.g. LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_ADVANCE) changes the effective threshold

adversarial.desc: A typo / negative / absurdly-large env value falls back to the default and never yields NaN or Infinity

items.title: Smoke test replaying the B-f458 signature and a healthy control
items.context: Synthetic story.events with 89 advances / 131:31 pass / 65 takeovers -> assert the breaker trips on each reason, auto-recovers exactly once, freezes on re-trip, blocks mutating commands, and the human-ack path clears it; and a healthy 8-advance converging story never trips. Wire into the package.json test script like the other *-smoke suites.
items.userSees: npm run test:convergence-breaker prints "PASS convergence-breaker: B-f458 signature trips + freezes on re-trip + ack clears + healthy control never trips" and exits 0.

happy.desc: Replaying the B-f458 signature (89 advances / 131:31 pass / 65 takeovers) trips the breaker on each reason and freezes on re-trip

edge.desc: A healthy 8-advance converging control story never trips the breaker

adversarial.desc: The autopilot self-ack refusal and the gitignored-state assertion both hold in the smoke

items.title: Fourth signal: repeated-identical-gate-failure counter (bump at failure site, reset on advance)
items.context: INIT-002 REVERSAL. My PLAN decision.json wrongly claimed gate rejections are 'not persisted anywhere', so I excluded this signal. That premise is FALSE: cli-engine.ts:1256-1260 already writes {command, success:false, error.message} to activity.jsonl on any command failure, with activeStory + cmd + error all in scope at that catch site. So the signal IS read-only derivable. Implement it the SAME cheap way as the takeover counter (NO hot-path activity-log scan): at the cli-engine failure catch, when a story-scoped command fails, bump a per-story gate-failure-counts.json keyed by digest(command + normalized error reason) -> {count,lastReason,lastAt}; on a SUCCESSFUL story_advance, reset that story's gate-failure-counts. assessBreaker (CHK-001) reads the max per-key count and trips when >= LATTICE_CONVERGENCE_MAX_GATE_REPEAT (CHK-004, default ~2). Sharpest/earliest brake: catches the B-f458 DEV<->REVIEW same-reason oscillation at 2 repeats, hours before advance-count reaches ~20. Evidence note: B-f458 pass-rate was ~23.7% overall (31/131), ~9.5% post-16:00 (42/4) -- correcting the stale '<10%' in CHK-004.
items.userSees: The smoke prints: after two story_advance failures with the same reason digest, gate-failure-counts.json shows count=2 and assessBreaker returns tripped=true reason='gate-repeat story_advance/<digest> 2>=2'; a successful story_advance resets the counter to 0.

happy.desc: Two story_advance failures with identical (command,reason) digest bump gate-failure-counts.json to count=2; assessBreaker trips with the gate-repeat reason.

edge.desc: A successful story_advance resets the per-story gate-failure counter to 0; two failures with DIFFERENT reasons stay at count=1 each and do not trip.

adversarial.desc: Missing/corrupt gate-failure-counts.json fails open (count=0, never throws); a malformed error message still yields a stable digest and never crashes the failure catch path.

auditLog.reason: INIT-002 reversal: gate failures ARE persisted (cli-engine.ts:1256-1260 -> activity.jsonl); add the 4th signal as its own item with a cheap per-story counter before DEV, per user directive.
